title: Join us on Friday, March 27th, 2026 for our next session of the Public Webinar Series!
bodyHtml:
? Unlock New Opportunities with the Knowledge Center: Scientific Updates & Can’t-Miss Events

? Friday, March 27, 2026
⏰ 1:00–2:00 PM ET

Join us for an engaging webinar where we’ll showcase the latest updates to the CFDE Knowledge Center and highlight exciting upcoming opportunities to connect with the community.

In this session, you will:

✨ Explore new features and enhancements on cfdeknowledgecenter.org

? See how the platform can support your research and discovery

? Learn about upcoming outreach events and engagement opportunities

? Ask questions and interact with the team in real time

Whether you're a current user or new to CFDE, this webinar is a great opportunity to discover how the Knowledge Center can help accelerate your work and connect you with valuable resources

? Register here: https://broadinstitute.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_x0bGLLt4TbqFGlxlMM-T2A
